summary: Rabbi Harari explains the dispute between Rav Huna and Rav Nachman in Masekhet Baba Batra regarding building a wall adjacent to another wall built higher than four amot. He discusses how Rashi, Rashbam, Tosafot, and Hazon Ish interpret the actions of the wall builder and whether building parallel to a wall requires paying for the entire wall. He also covers cases where features like windows or beam sockets were included in the wall.

questions: What is the dispute between Rav Huna and Rav Nachman regarding building a wall adjacent to another wall?
How do Rashi and Rashbam explain why a person might have to pay for the full height of a wall?
What logic does the Hazon Ish offer to explain the opinion of Rav Huna?
What building features prove whether a person intends to extend a wall further?
Does adding carved windows or beam holes in a wall prove that the other party paid for it?
